evals.name: live-orders-status-migration
evals.prompt: We need to add a NOT NULL status column to orders and an index, on a live production table. Review and rewrite db/migrations/001_add_status.sql safely.
evals.expected_output: Expand/contract plan, lock timeouts, concurrent index, validated constraint, batched backfill, verification, and rollback/cleanup.
assertions: Rejects running the migration as one blocking step
Uses CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY for the live table
Adds the column/constraint in a backward-compatible expand phase
Batches the backfill instead of one large UPDATE
